messages.subject: Account Suspended Without Reason
parts:
Hi,

I recently had to update an app from an old Windows 64 bit machine. Pushing the app gave me the error: "R-Shiny: Error:could not find function “xpath_element”, so I updated  R and every package. After all the installations, my credentials were gone. When I went to my account I wasn't allowed to create a new token, and I saw a broken message about an account suspension (see the attached image). I also recently upgraded to a paid plan and the account now says I'm still on the free one. Any help to fix this problem would be appreciated.
